title: funding_row/v1
description: One settled funding print as a JSONL line in a pack's funding.jsonl. Rows carry no per-row schema field (bulk-data exception; the file's schema is declared in pack_manifest.files[]). Deviation from the dev-plan sketch {ts, rate_1e8}: available_at is added so that ONE uniform point-in-time rule (available_at <= virtual clock) covers every observable row type with no per-type special case (ISO-1).

ts.description: Settlement instant, UTC epoch-milliseconds, venue-accurate (00/08/16 UTC for V1 Binance BTCUSDT). Pack validators assert stamps land exactly on the market's declared settlement offsets.

available_at.description: Instant the print becomes observable. Always equal to ts (a funding rate is knowable the instant it settles); present so the ISO-1 filter is one mechanical rule over all row types. Pack validators assert available_at == ts.

rate_1e8.description: Settled funding rate in 1e-8 units, signed; positive = longs pay shorts. Era cap already applied as recorded by the venue: |rate_1e8| <= the market's funding.cap_1e8 (2020-era Binance: 300000 = 0.30%; the COVID 2020-03-13 08:00 print sits exactly at -300000).
